# Round 6 (B): loss frame minus gain frame (S2), the loss-aversion test

Identical payoffs; the two arms differ only in the paragraph on the firm's account, the account line of every question and the wording of penalties in the history. Primary measure: cartel formation (Haiku 5.5) and average price (Sonnet 5.5, which forms no cartel under any prohibition). Laissez-faire has no penalties and is the control.
